root_text: INR 9.5 lakh crore wiped out in a day! Sensex & Nifty dip 1.5% as India reports first #HMPV cases in Karnataka & Gujarat. Weak US market cues & economic uncertainty add to the crash. Investors remain cautious amid volatile trend
